body:
Follow-up to PR [Bare-number citation hook: link-title notes reworded after PR 1265's review; a wrong number listed 11th is tested](https://github.com/nedschorus/nedschorus/pull/1279), for merge-lane-2's three items.

## 1. Message parts the citations test never scanned

mac-claude review 5511062659, :191. `registered-hook-messages-carry-no-citations-test.py` picks the constants it scans by the ending of their names. Four parts of this hook's link-title notes reach agents only through `format()`, under names it never scanned. They are renamed:

| Old name | New name |
|---|---|
| `WRONG_NUMBER_LINE_OPENING` | `WRONG_NUMBER_LINE_OPENING_INSTRUCTION` |
| `WRONG_NUMBER_TITLE_LINES_OVERRIDE` | `WRONG_NUMBER_TITLE_LINES_OVERRIDE_INSTRUCTION` |
| `NO_CORRECTION_NOW_SENTENCE` | `NO_CORRECTION_NOW_INSTRUCTION` |
| `WRONG_NUMBER_NOTE` | `WRONG_NUMBER_NOTE_TEMPLATE` |

To check the fix, I put a citation into one of these constants in a `-mutation-testing-worktree` copy, and the citations test failed.

**Count across the other registered hooks:** 19 more module-level message constants, in 7 other hooks, reach agents under names the test does not scan:
- `.claude/hooks/ghi-issue-write-redirect.py`: 11 (`RECORD_LINE_NO_FILE`, `RECORD_LINE_ONE_FILE`, `RECORD_LINE_SEVERAL_FILES`, `RECORD_LINE_LOOKUP_FAILED`, `REOPEN_OUTCOME`, `COMMENT_OUTCOME`, `CLOSE_WITH_COMMENT_REFUSAL_NO_FILE`, `TITLE_LINES_ONE_FILE`, `TITLE_LINE_SEVERAL_FILES`, `TITLE_LINES_LOOKUP_FAILED`, `DELETE_REFUSAL_NO_FILE`)
- `scripts/post-compaction-session-continues-hook.py`: 3 (`TAIL_HEADING`, `MARKER_NOT_CLEARED_COST`, `TAIL_NOT_RECOVERED_COST`)
- `scripts/cold-read-fast-read-due-for-linked-document-reminder-hook.py`: `REMINDER_OPENING`
- `scripts/force-push-with-open-pull-request-guard-hook.py`: `BUDGET_SPENT_DETAIL`
- `scripts/hand-typed-codex-exec-redirect-hook.py`: `REFUSAL`, a bare name that no ending matches
- `.claude/hooks/instruction-file-guard.py`: `COLD_READ_BEFORE_ASKING_SENTENCES`
- `scripts/new-shared-names-reminder-hook.py`: `LOCAL_BRANCH_LIST_FAILURE`

The search also flagged two constants that are not messages: `checkout-freshness-catch-up.py`'s `GIT_UNTRACKED_FILE_WOULD_BE_OVERWRITTEN_TEXT`, which is git output the program matches, and this hook's regex `READING_LIST`. I found the constants by listing every uppercase module-level string, or tuple of strings, with four or more spaces in at least one string and a name the test does not match.

Root cause not fixed: the test finds messages through a naming convention that nothing enforces. Those 19 constants belong to other hooks and owners, so this PR fixes only this hook's.

## 2. A test that crashed instead of failing

The test at :377 used `min(note.index(...) ...)`, which raised an error and stopped the whole file when "If a later reply" left the note. It now compares `note.find()` results. With the phrase removed, in a `-mutation-testing-worktree` copy, the file exits 1 with two FAIL lines and no traceback. No other `.index(` call sits inside a check in this test file.

Root cause: `str.index` raises when its text is missing, and the check evaluated it before `check()` could record a FAIL, so one missing phrase stopped the whole file. No other `.index(` call sits inside a check in this test file, so this case was the only one.

## 3. Notes, after one fast read of all twelve forms

merge-lane-2's fast-read notes in `pr-1279-fix-round-2-link-title-notes-2026-10-13-2`:
- **Q2.5:** "do not apply to it" now reads "do not apply to that link".
- **Q2.4:** "words with no number stay as written" is removed. That case cannot arise, because a link flagged for a wrong number always has a number in its text.
- **Q2.2:** the form to write now gives both `PR <number>, "<title>"` and `GHI <number>: <title>`.

I then rendered all twelve note forms and gave them one fast read together: `nedlern@ned-box:/home/nedlern/nedschorus-logs/cold-read-records/citation-link-title-all-combinations-2026-10-13-2`. That read led to two more changes:
- the summary now says the text "is not the title GitHub reports, or whose number is not the link's";
- the "more not listed" line now asks for both kinds of link.

## Checks

- 250 cases pass.
- Affected suites, from this run's own SUMMARY line in `/tmp/run-all-test-suites-pu_v12ik`: 16 passed, 0 failed.
- branch-conflict-check reported CLEAN.
